description: Assess fiction manuscripts and run a staged developmental-to-publication edit flow. Use when reading a novel draft or compiled manuscript to diagnose scene thinness, pacing, subtext, foreshadowing, emotional payoff, relationship arcs, or publication readiness, especially when turning a PDF or rough draft into an edited source, review packet, EPUB, and print-ready files.
